reason: The GL Code combobox has autocomplete="garbage", which axe reads as an invalid token. The field collects no information about the user and has no WCAG input purpose, so the token hides nothing from any user and 1.3.5 does not fail. On both sampled states it is an accounting category picker.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 applies only to input fields that collect information about the user and serve one of the input purposes WCAG lists, such as name, email or street address. An accounting GL Code is not one of them, so there is no purpose to identify and no token to get wrong. The value autocomplete="garbage" is a deliberate autofill opt-out, set with the data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore attributes where the field has them, and browsers treat an unknown token as no purpose. 4.1.2 is not affected: the accessibility tree gives the field its name, role and state. No other A or AA criterion covers the attribute.
